text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's run overwhelmed the crowd. 
However, after the race, she was 
completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to her older sister, Biwa 
Hayahide, she hasn't been running her 
"true running style."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer looks into the data to find 
the cause. Narita Brian simply lacks 
experience running in large packs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we unravel the factors behind this, her 
weaknesses should become clear. We need to 
overcome them before the next Asahi Hai 
FS...
